title: Microsoft Purview: OCR scanning of images for DLP in SharePoint and OneDrive (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents that pay-as-you-go licensing and the services requiring it are not yet available in GCC, rather than leaving that availability unstated. The cost-estimator advice omits exclusions that can understate SharePoint and OneDrive bills, and the stated opt-in default conflicts with the page's acknowledgement that the government-cloud arrival behaviour is unknown.
